evidence: Carries the Utils/log/libs label and modifies cryptographic primitive integration (src/crypto/sha256.* and libsecp256k1 context setup).
rationale: Plugging hardware-optimized SHA256 into libsecp256k1 delivers notable signing speedups while removing boilerplate context management across the codebase. Benchmarks demonstrate a 13% reduction in ECDSASign latency and 7% in SchnorrSign latency on ARM64, and retiring ECC_Context cleans up initialization across dozens of binaries and tests.
